# three.js

Pinned version: **0.187.0**, MIT license.

These locally served production modules avoid a runtime dependency on a public
CDN. `three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are the unmodified minified npm build
files, named to match the module's relative imports. License text is included in
`THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

Sources:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.187.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.187.0/build/three.core.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.187.0/LICENSE

The library is imported only when one of the WebGL pilot scenes is selected.
